zh: 修复 Word 正文和公式编辑区长拼音组字被打断的问题，组字完成后再同步预览。完善 Word 自动加载，以及旧 MathType 公式的编号、章节与交叉引用更新。细化手动编辑的结构提示和求和上下标操作，改善矩阵括号、颜色和中文标注的显示，保留预览面板内容，并调整应用图标留白。
en: Fixes interrupted long Pinyin composition in Word and the formula editors by deferring preview synchronization until composition ends. Improves Word startup and legacy MathType numbering, chapters, sections, and references. Refines structure cues and sum limits for manual editing, improves matrix delimiters, colors, and Chinese annotations, retains preview panel content, and adjusts app icon spacing.
